title: EESP: code and results for "Ensemble Exhaustive-Subsample Partitioning: What Subsample Ensembles Estimate in Clusterwise Least Squares, and When They Are Worth Using"
description:
Code and raw results for S. Orujov, Ensemble Exhaustive-Subsample Partitioning: What Subsample Ensembles Estimate in Clusterwise Least Squares, and When They Are Worth Using (2026).

The archive contains the Python implementation of EESP (exact branch-and-bound micro-solves, alignment, vote, averaging and selection), the adaptively trimmed variant, the competitors (multistart hard alternation, emEM, trimmed alternation with reweighting), the exact K=2 clusterwise-regression oracle, the experiment scripts, the cluster chunk runner, unit tests, and the raw result files behind every table and figure. Running make_outputs.py regenerates all tables and figures from the stored results; every experiment unit is seeded, so rerunning the experiments reproduces the results exactly (timings excepted).

The tone, NO and CO2 data sets are those of the R package mixtools and are not redistributed; US GNP and the NBER recession indicator are from FRED.
